members.name: nodes

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: The tree data source. Each node is described by an id, label, and optional fields such as children and disabled.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The id of the selected node, controlled with v-model; null means no node is selected.

members.name: checkedIds
members.description: The ids of checked nodes in checkbox mode, controlled with v-model:checkedIds.

members.name: selectionMode
members.description: The selection mode: single selects one node, while checkbox allows multiple checked nodes.

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.description: Node ids expanded on initial render; subsequent expansion state is maintained internally.

members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the tree root container.

members.name: draggable
members.description: Enables node drag-and-drop sorting and updates the node data after a drop.

members.name: allowDrag

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Decides whether dragging may start for a node; all nodes are draggable when omitted.

members.name: allowDrop

type.text: ((dragNode: TreeNode<unknown>, dropNode: TreeNode<unknown>, dropType: "before" | "after" | "inner") => boolean) | undefined

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Decides whether a dragged node may be placed before, after, or inside a target node.

members.name: lazy
members.description: Enables lazy node loading and calls load when an unloaded node is expanded.

members.name: load

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Asynchronously loads children for a node; the returned nodes are written into the tree data.

members.name: retryOnError
members.description: Shows a retry action after a load failure and requests that node again when activated.

members.name: filterable
members.description: Enables node filtering; provide a query through the exposed filter method.

members.name: filterMethod

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Custom node matching rule. Return true to keep a node; when omitted, the query is matched against its label.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emits the new selected node id when selection changes, or null when selection is cleared.

members.name: select

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the selected node as a TreeNode when the user selects it.

members.name: expand
members.description: Emits a node id and its new expanded state when the node is expanded or collapsed.

members.name: update:checkedIds
members.description: Emits the updated list of checked node ids when the checked set changes.

members.name: update:expanded
members.description: Emits the updated list of expanded node ids when the expanded set changes.

members.name: update:nodes

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the updated tree data after drag-and-drop changes the node order or parent.

members.name: check

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the node and its new checked state when its checkbox changes.

members.name: node-drag-start

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the native DragEvent and dragged node when dragging starts.

members.name: node-drag-enter

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the DragEvent and node when the pointer enters that node during a drag.

members.name: node-drag-leave

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the DragEvent and node when the pointer leaves that node during a drag.

members.name: node-drag-over

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the DragEvent and node while the pointer moves over that node during a drag.

members.name: node-drag-end

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the DragEvent and dragged node when dragging ends.

members.name: node-drop

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the DragEvent, target node, and before, after, or inner drop position after a successful drop.

members.name: filter
members.description: Filters nodes by query text; pass an empty string to restore all nodes.

members.name: reloadNode
members.description: Reloads the children of the specified node to refresh its lazy-loaded data.

members.name: node

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: The tree node represented by this row.

members.name: selectedId
members.description: The currently selected node id, used to determine whether this row is selected.

members.name: expandedIds
members.description: The set of expanded node ids, used to determine this node’s expanded state.

members.name: depth
members.description: The node’s depth in the tree, used to calculate row indentation.

members.name: isFirstRoot
members.description: Marks whether this is the first root node for root-row layout.

members.name: selectionMode
members.description: The selection mode for this row, determining single selection or checkbox interaction.

members.name: checkedIds
members.description: The set of checked node ids, used to render checkbox state.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables selection, checking, and keyboard activation for this node.

members.name: select

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits the full node data when this node is activated or selected.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Emits this node id when its expanded state should toggle.

members.name: check

references.name: TreeNode

members.description: Emits this node when its checkbox state should toggle.

members.name: focus-prev
members.description: Requests moving focus to the previous visible tree node.

members.name: focus-next
members.description: Requests moving focus to the next visible tree node.

members.name: focus-parent
members.description: Requests moving focus to the parent node.

members.name: focus-first-child
members.description: Requests moving focus to the first child when the node is expanded.

members.name: focus-first
members.description: Requests moving focus to the first visible node in the tree.

members.name: focus-last
members.description: Requests moving focus to the last visible node in the tree.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to the tree item element for this node.

members.name: nodeId
members.description: The id of the node represented by this row.
